name: Fabtech Custom Metal Fabrication & Welding
old_description: CNC Punching, Plasma Cutting, Oxy-Acetylene Cutting, & Brake Press Forming.
about:
Fabtech LLC operates from Prosperity, West Virginia, serving the surrounding region from a facility on Racetrack Road. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but presents itself as a limited liability company focused on custom metal fabrication.

The shop runs CNC punching, plasma cutting, oxy-acetylene cutting, and brake press forming equipment alongside TIG welding, tube bending, and stainless steel polishing and graining capabilities. An in-house powder coating line with an 8-by-8-by-20-foot batch oven allows finished parts to leave the facility fully coated. The company states it can produce anything from a single prototype to hundreds of units.

Customers span the restaurant industry, where Fabtech performs on-site repair of stainless countertops and sinks, as well as the automotive sector through custom aluminum and steel truck beds. The shop also builds NEMA-style electrical enclosures, modular control rooms, computer consoles, workstations, custom trailers, steel security products, handrails, and reproduces hard-to-find or obsolete parts.

Fabtech positions itself as a one-stop shop for metal fabrication, emphasizing a guarantee to rework any unsatisfactory result. It highlights its ability to fabricate stainless steel and aluminum assemblies with post-treatment polishing and re-graining as a differentiator in its market area.
